incident-bot: [ALERT] Pager: model-serving-prod (us-west1) high latency spike (p95 ~ 2.1s). Severity: P2. Please ACK within 5m. Alert: https://alerts.redwood.internal/alert/8231 :rotating_light:
Maya R: acked — I'm primary oncall, jumping in. Seeing increased 5xxs + timeouts from frontend dashboards. Will check batching and cache first.
Priya K: i'm secondary, on standby. if maya needs me to take traffic, say the word.
Sam L: quick thought — if it's KV cache misses skyrocketing we can temporarily route traffic to `model-v1-small` to reduce latency while we warm caches.
Maya R: good call. starting with metrics: checking cache hitratio and batch sizes. probed metrics API:```
curl -sS "https://metrics.redwood/api/query?metric=kv_cache_hit_ratio&env=prod&region=us-west1"
# then check router traces for batching
curl -sS "https://traces.redwood/api/search?q=route%3Amodel-serving-prod"
```
Maya R: cache miss rate up to 72% (normal ~12%). batch sizes collapsed to 1-2 reqs per batch. looks like upstream clients are sending uneven bursty requests.
Priya K: i'll prep the fallback route if you want me to flip it. command for routing (console/API):```
# api call to create a temporary route override
POST /admin/v1/routes/override
{
  "service": "model-serving-prod",
  "target": "model-v1-small",
  "duration": "30m",
  "reason": "latency mitigation"
}
```
Sam L: if you flip, add sticky header so the same session doesn't oscillate between variants (sets `x-rw-model-fallback: true`).
Jon P: tagging escalation rules — if this isn't reduced to p95 < 800ms within 10m after mitigation, escalate to oncall-manager @Ash M and page the SRE lead. page message template: `P2 model-serving-prod high latency — mitigations: fallback route and cache-warm attempt. Need manager-level support to open capacity or escalate infra.`
Maya R: flipping fallback in 30s, will monitor. also warming cache with `evict_and_prefill` for hot prefixes. running:```
python tools/cache_warm.py --service model-serving-prod --prefix "/v1/completions" --parallel 6
```
Maya R: logs show autoscaler keeping cycles spinning up and tearing down (frequent scale events). snippet:
```
2026-03-15T02:03:12Z scaler: scale_up reason=cpu_burst target=4
2026-03-15T02:03:37Z scaler: scale_down reason=idlekick target=1
2026-03-15T02:04:01Z scaler: scale_up reason=burst target=4
```
Priya K: that explains the cold-kv behavior — nodes not stabilizing means cache warm doesn't stick. Recommend temp routing + request to infra to pin min replicas to 3 for 20m. if infra needs a page, i'll do it.
Sam L: sent a DM to infra on-call with the scale request link.
Maya R: after fallback flip p95 dropped to ~730ms, errors down ~80%. leaving fallback for 25m while we stabilize. recording mitigation actions in incident doc.
incident-bot: note added to incident 8231: mitigation_action=temporary_fallback, cache_warm_started=true, autoscaler_instability=true.
Maya R: quick customer impact summary for the incident doc: "Some customers experienced elevated latency and intermittent POST timeouts for ~12 minutes before mitigation. Impact isolated to us-west1; no data loss."
Jon P: good summary. make sure to include when you hand off: primary transfer plan.
Maya R: handoff plan -> I'm primary until 03:00Z. Priya will take over after that. Handoff checklist: 1) confirm fallback still active and p95 < 850ms for 10m, 2) confirm autoscaler min_replicas set to 3 and infra acked, 3) leave notes on incident doc with commands you ran and results, 4) if metrics regress, page @Ash M with the template above.
Priya K: got it. I'll join the incident doc now and prep the takeover.
Sam L: leaving a short playbook snippet for future quick ops: - check `kv_cache_hit_ratio`, `batch_size_dist`, `autoscaler_events` - if miss_rate > 50% try fallback + cache_warm - if autoscaler flaps, request min_replicas pin and page infra.
Maya R: handing off to Priya at 03:00Z as planned. tagging postmortem owner: @Jon P. I'll paste final metric snapshots before I leave.
Maya R: final quick note: if anyone gets paged after 03:00Z with similar symptoms, assume fallback is in place and start with autoscaler stability check before flipping routes.
Priya K: acknowledge and will take over. :thumbsup:
